description: Tell us an answer was good or bad. FREE. Use it when a result is wrong — empty markdown, a control map missing a button, data that does not match the page — with the url or the jobId so it can be reproduced. It is the only way we learn that we read a page badly: our logs cannot tell that apart from a page that is simply like that. Reference for the oassis API: https://oassis.dev/openapi.json

comment.description: What you expected and what you got.

reference.description: The jobId or sessionId it happened on, so it can be looked up.

route.description: Which tool or endpoint it is about, as you called it.

url.description: The page that came out wrong: usually the fastest way to reproduce it.

verdict.description: Did the answer do the job or not.

name: web_feedback
